title: Hanse Talks About Ancient Smithy Hammers
bodyHtml:
I'm currently researching a fix for an issue with ancient smithy hammers. If you'd like to give some feedback, please let me know in this thread.

Design:
Ancient smithy hammers (ASH's) are designed to allow you to craft high-end smith items with a lower chance to fail, thus taking up less resources. The hammer is not intended to be a replacement for a powerscroll. If you craft with the hammer, it should take a charge off the hammer until it is out of charges.

To get the blacksmith skill bonus, you must have the ASH equipped.

If you use a runic hammer from your backpack, it should take a charge from both the runic hammer and the ancient smithy hammer. This is to avoid having an infinite use ancient smithy hammer.

If you use a normal hammer from your backpack, it should state that you have a hammer equipped and not allow you to craft with it. Use the ancient smithy hammer instead to craft while it is equipped.

That's it!
